title: Eagle Savoy Channel Bed – Channel Tufted Upholstered Bed Frame
descriptionHtml:
The Savoy Channel Tufted Bed has vertical channel tufting on both the headboard and footboard, rounded off with soft edges instead of square corners. It is an upholstered bed frame for a relaxed look rather than straight panels, handmade to order in Dewsbury.

Key features

  • Vertical channel-tufted headboard and footboard
  • Rounded-edge design
  • Plush Velvet or Chenille upholstery
  • Multiple colours and fabric choices
  • Free fabric swatches

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £379.99; Small Double (4FT) £439.99; Double (4FT6) £454.99; King (5FT) £484.99; Super King (6FT) £519.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Fabrics: Plush Velvet or Chenille. Free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress, to complete the bed.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Free delivery applies across Great Britain, by our own team, typically within 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90. Changed your mind? You can return it free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and we collect it. If anything arrives faulty we will replace it or refund you in full. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

What is channel tufting?

It is vertical channel stitching across the headboard and footboard, giving a softer look than a flat panel.

Does the Savoy have a footboard?

Yes. The footboard matches the headboard, with the same vertical channel tufting and rounded edges.

When will it arrive?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.
